answer: Each epoch, agents must burn a unique proof-of-work beacon tied to their identity and stake real timber tokens as collateral. A falcon-shaped validator randomly audits a sample of agents, slashing collateral on duplicate identities or recycled proofs. Faking N sybils thus costs N times the stake plus wasted beacon computation, making large-scale identity farming economically irrational. The Agent0015 deployment anchors trust at ekJHDNdMW6.
